source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the industrial applications of nylon (PDF 151-152).

items: Kapre (jurabein, varzish aur tairaki ke kapre), qaleen aur rassiyan, mazbooti aur lachak ki wajah se; is ka kapra barsatiyon aur varzish ke kapron mein use hota hai.
Gaariyon ki sanat ke mechanical purze, jaise gears, bearings, bushings, engine covers aur fuel lines, mazbooti, kam ragar aur garmi ki bardasht ki wajah se.
Machine ke purze jaise screws, nuts aur bolts, jahan mazbooti aur ghisaav ki bardasht chahiye.
Rassiyan, machhli ke jaal aur dor, tanao ki zyada taqat aur paani mein ghisaav ki bardasht ki wajah se.
Sarifeen ki ashya jaise zips, toothbrush, hairbrush aur kai dhale plastic purze.

blocks.prompt: Nylon machhli ke jaal mein kyun use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki tanao ki taqat zyada aur yeh paani mein ghisaav bardasht karta hai.

items: Nylon ke istemal: kapre, qaleen, rassiyan, gears aur bearings, screws aur bolts, machhli ke jaal, zips aur brush.
